title: Topological Models for Categories Associated with the Weighted Projective Lines of Type $(2,2,2,2)$
summary: We construct a geometric model for the derived category of the weighted projective line $\mathbb{CP}^1_ω$ of type $(2,2,2,2)$ using a graded sphere with four binaries. More precisely, we give a bijection between the set of indecomposable rigid objects and the set of certain arcs, such that the dimensions of $\operatorname{Hom}$-spaces are computed by oriented intersection numbers.
